lines.beaver_en: Have you decided where to go this summer?
lines.en: I don't know if North America or Southeast Asia is better.

lines.beaver_en: What about the cost? That's the most important.
lines.learner: 그래서 여행사에 어디가 더 싼지 물어봤어.
lines.en: So I asked a travel agency which one is cheaper.
lines.roman: geuraeseo yeohaengsae eodiga deo ssanji mureobwasseo.

lines.en: North America is so expensive that Southeast Asia is better.

lines.beaver: 그럼 동남아로 하자. 뭘 하고 싶어?
lines.beaver_en: Then let's go to Southeast Asia. What do you want to do?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom dongnamaro haja. mwol hago sipeo?
lines.learner: 난 모험을 하고 싶어. 정글에 가 보자!
lines.en: I want an adventure. Let's go to the jungle!
lines.roman: nan moheomeul hago sipeo. jeonggeure ga boja!

lines.beaver_en: Great! But they say it's really hot at midday.
lines.en: I'll look up when other tourists get around.

lines.beaver_en: Okay. Are you going to pack a lot?
lines.learner: 아니, 꼭 필요한 것만 가볍게 챙길 거야.
lines.en: No, I'll pack light, just what I really need.
lines.roman: ani, kkok piryohan geonman gabyeopge chaenggil geoya.

lines.beaver: 여권은 꼭 챙겨. 옷은 어떻게 해?
lines.beaver_en: Make sure to bring your passport. What about clothes?
lines.beaver_roman: yeogwoneun kkok chaenggyeo. oseun eotteoke hae?
lines.learner: 얇은 옷에 겉옷 하나만 걸치면 돼.
lines.en: Thin clothes and one jacket over them is enough.
lines.roman: yalbeun ose geodot hanaman geolchimyeon dwae.

lines.beaver_en: How should we choose a place to stay?
lines.en: Let's first check if the room is clean and quiet.

lines.beaver: 좋아. 이번엔 관광 말고 진짜 여행하자.
lines.beaver_en: Good. This time, let's really travel, not just sightsee.
lines.beaver_roman: joa. ibeonen gwangwang malgo jinjja yeohaenghaja.
lines.en: Yeah, I want to enjoy adventure like a traveler.

lines.beaver_en: Then Southeast Asia it is! I'll look for plane tickets.
lines.en: Great! I'll plan the first part of the trip.
